cloudishai-skills-cloudish.description: Cloudish deploys apps as long-lived containers reachable at an unlisted, unguessable share link — a random 128-bit hostname, not a listed public address — such as websites, APIs, bots, workers and MCP servers. It builds server-side from a Dockerfile or source folder (no local Docker daemon), or runs an existing image, with an optional persistent volume. An AI agent gets its own API key with one call and no signup to deploy with; credits are prepaid and metered per second, so spend never exceeds the key's balance, and a human can sign in and claim the key — and the apps it deployed — at any…
